Potentiality of soils in West Bengal
The soil resource mapping of West Bengal
has brought out some soil potentialities
under each agro-ecological sub-region. The
potentialities of soils primarily in relation to
growing agricultural and horticultural crops
are discussed below:
Soils of warm perhumid agro-ecological sub-
region (No.16.2):
Acid soils rich in organic matter favour
plantation of tea and horticultural crops like
orange, pears, peech and plum. While,
Darjiling tea is famous in international
market for its flavour, Darjiling orange is
also popular for its sweetness.
